For reviewer reference, the AS major prints: '18 units from the following:' ATEC 1 (2), ATEC 22B (8) or ATEC 25 (4) and ATEC 26 (4), ATEC 51 (2), ATEC 52 (3), ATEC 53 (3); then '9-12 units from the following:' ATEC 21 (2.5), ATEC 22A (8) or ATEC 23 (4) and ATEC 24 (4), ATEC 34 (4), ATEC 35 (4), ATEC 81 (3). Total Major Units: 27-30. GE: ECC GE 24 units (local degrees) or Cal-GETC 34 units (transfer degrees); electives as needed to reach a minimum of 60 degree-applicable units; Minimum Degree Total: 60 units.

The AS major range of 27-30 units does not fit strictly within the certificate band of 16 to fewer than 30 units, so the certificate's requirements may differ from the AS major; check the college's certificate page.
